- Incidental charges (mini-bar, phone, etc.) are not covered by Redwood corporate policy — attendees will be asked to pay and expense.
- Per-card daily limit: set at $1,200 for lodging. We can increase for special cases if you flag them.

Action items:

2) Sarah: confirm which reservations must stay on a single invoice vs. billed per room.
3) I’ll pull in Marissa for any billing impacts to the deal.

Important flag: during last month’s Vegas workshop one lodging charge (merchant: Grand Meridian Hotel) was posted to our central travel card instead of the per-attendee virtual card due to a merchant token mismatch. We’ll need Monarch to confirm the merchant record for the reservation so we can request a reversal and reissue the charge to the correct virtual card. If Monarch prefers a refund on their side that’s fine too — we’ll reallocate funds to the attendee card and make any required JE across the advance bucket.
